title: Disposition Hover Per Tile Only
description: Fix projektetage (presentation renderer): hovering a disposition should only highlight that disposition, not the entire visual row band.
summary:
Fixed disposition hover highlighting entire visual row on split-tile slides (e.g. projektetage Bauteilkatalog).

Root cause: PresentationRowHoverContext set hoveredRowBandId on pointer enter for any tile or row-band hit target, applying presentation-interactive-disposition--row-hovered to all tiles sharing that row band (CSS showed primary tint on non-hovered siblings).

Fix: removed row-level hover state, pointer handlers, context provider, and row-hovered CSS. Per-tile :hover on each interactive disposition remains; row bands still support multi-tile selection on click.

57 renderer tests pass.
